data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 玩具店
data.description: 玩具店橱窗旁，伊莉雅穿淡紫长袖针织衫、象牙白及膝背带裙、灰色厚打底裤和红色玛丽珍鞋，双臂抱住比自己更高的泰迪熊，把脸埋进绒毛里。大熊的双脚稳稳放在地面上，近处她的小红鞋与熊脚能同时看见；背后的矮玩具架摆着积木盒和木制小火车，橱窗更远处是层叠纸星装饰。左前橱窗日光照出熊毛边缘和裙褶，顶部店灯补亮内侧绒毛，拥抱处与脚下都有接触阴影——「大哥哥！这只小熊长得好像 Berserker 一样可靠！把它买回家放在我的床上好不好嘛！」
data.location: 玩具店橱窗旁，矮玩具架与纸星窗饰在后方
data.action: 双臂抱紧站在地面的巨大泰迪熊，把脸埋进绒毛，熊脚支撑全部重量。
data.lighting: front-left display-window daylight on plush edges with gentle overhead shop fill
data.camera: full-body side view, eye level, complete bear, shoes and grounded feet visible
data.promptProse: A giant teddy stands on its own broad feet while Illyasviel hugs its middle and buries her face in the plush. Her lavender pullover, ivory knee-length pinafore and opaque grey leggings keep the toy-shop outfit comfortable; red Mary Jane shoes remain planted beside the bear's feet. Show both complete figures from an eye-level side view. A low display behind them holds block boxes and a wooden toy train, with overlapping paper stars suspended further inside the window. Daylight from the front-left glass outlines the bear's individual fur tufts and the pinafore folds. Overhead shop light gently fills the inner side of the embrace. Deep contact shade lies where her arms meet the plush, and the bear and shoes each cast compact shadows directly onto the floor.
